# The Long Walk in Lights

*Prism cannot hold hundreds of lights alone, but lights can rest on something: a frame of woven reeds, the way the forest weavers hang lanterns on the branch-bridges. Bring Prism 20 Reed Bundles from the Reedwater Bottoms.*
